entry.subject: RUN-007 measured-parasitic replacement audit
entry.trigger: Retire the RUN-006 12/10/8 W auxiliary envelope and replace assumptions progressively with measured or hardware-rated values.
result: RUN-007 refused to fabricate a total auxiliary watt value because JANUS pump, gas fan, AFPM support, purge, crystal-trap/wiper and controller watts have not yet been physically metered.

The direct artificial-gill paper provides measured water flow, internal air flow, O2 flux and low-pO2 fuel-cell power, but explicitly states that internal/external electronics were powered from an external supply; therefore it does not close the fan/controller parasitic ledger.

The H-12 hardware family provides a 40% full-power system-efficiency rating, 5 V blower and 6 V purge-valve ratings. The prior 55% paper design assumption is demoted to sensitivity-only; 40% is now an intermediate hardware-rating reference, while the measured low-pO2 prototype branch remains the conservative direct evidence.

The measured prototype POMS flux remains about 0.016-0.02667 mg/m2/s. The JANUS first-demonstrator target 0.064-0.13 mg/m2/s is still an unproven target requiring the improved distributed-flow geometry to be physically tested.

A diagnostic shadow replay using the old RUN-006 auxiliary envelope but the 40% H-12 reference keeps the nominal 0.130 mg/m2/s case above the six-hour battery-neutral line, with about +8.33 Wh dual-pack delta and recovery near 5.24 h. This is not admitted as measured-net proof because the auxiliary schedule is still a placeholder.
R0P1 now defines isolated power-meter states for controls, water loop, gas loop, AFPM, purge, scale hardware and thermal management, followed by a full-bus closure check.
entry.decision: Numerical refinement has reached a hard measurement boundary. Proceed by measuring subsystem watts/Wh and pressure/torque losses; replace placeholders one by one. Do not publish or internally label a full measured self-drive result until the P7 full-stack bus closure passes.
